title: Atlas vocabulary term
description: One entry in an operator-managed controlled vocabulary (classification, subject, structure, tag, cast role, rejection reason, genre, ...). Pure data: no application code branches on a term. Assets reference the stable `id`, never the label. Design: docs/architecture/configuration-and-reference-data.md §2.3; data model: docs/architecture/data-model.md#13-taxonomy--vocab-entities--owned-by-mam-relational.

id.description: Stable identity. This is what assets, schedules and audit entries reference — renaming a label never rewrites a reference.

vocabulary.description: Which vocabulary this term belongs to. The SET of vocabularies is code-known (Tier 0 — each has its own table, index and UI); the TERMS are data.

key.description: Stable slug, unique per (vocabulary, channelId). Lets inbound feeds, imports and seed bundles map external values to terms without knowing Atlas ULIDs.

labels.description: Display labels by BCP-47 locale tag. Mutable — renaming is safe. At least one entry required.

description.description: Optional editorial guidance shown in the picker.

parentId.description: Only meaningful for hierarchical vocabularies (category). Null/absent for flat ones.

sortOrder.description: Manual ordering in pickers; ties broken by label collation.

external.description: Mappings to third-party identifiers, so feeds/EPG exports can round-trip this term.

deprecatedAt.description: Set INSTEAD of deleting: hides the term from pickers while every existing reference, archived asset and audit entry still resolves. Hard delete is offered only at zero references, and is audited.

replacedById.description: Set by a merge operation; readers follow the redirect so historical references stay valid. A merge is ONE audited event, not N retag writes.

usageCount.description: Denormalized reference count, maintained asynchronously. Drives the 'safe to delete?' affordance; never authoritative for enforcement.
